Spikes.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.

Stealth Rock.effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.

Sticky Web.effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.

decisions.scope: Persistent opposing-side field rules, no immediate hit and no layers. Fixed 1 typeless/Rock damage, or Dexterity -1 on actual entry.
decisions.protections: Heavy-Duty Boots blocks all three. Ground immunity blocks Spikes and Sticky Web. Damage uses existing indirect damage/type rules. Sticky Web uses sourced stat protection and non-stacking move channels.
decisions.reflection: Magic Bounce/Coat uses the existing field redirector. Mirror Armor stat reflection on entry uses the retained caster when conscious and active; absent/fainted source remains explicit atomic GM adjudication.
decisions.history: New encounter gate only; saved missing flags default false. No source JSON changes.
